title: Grouping Plasmoid on panels should pop up when clicked
line: In a panel, the Grouping widget now shows as an icon that opens its widgets in a popup.
explanation: The Grouping widget is a nested containment, and libplasma always treats containments as expanded, so it never gets the usual icon-plus-popup switch that panel applets have. In a panel it therefore drew its whole tab bar and stack inside the panel's thickness, leaving only squeezed tab titles. The change makes it show its own icon when its form factor is horizontal or vertical and moves the tab content into a standard AppletPopup (same setup as the system tray's), opened by clicking the icon or the widget's shortcut; on the desktop it stays inline as before.

commits.message:
applets/grouping: show contents in a popup when in a panel

In a panel the grouping widget squeezed its tab bar and all its widgets
into the panel's thickness, which left them unusable. It now shows its
icon there and opens the tabs in a popup, like other panel applets.

BUG: 412752

media.caption: A Grouping widget with a note, a calculator and a clock in the bottom panel: only squeezed tab titles show, nothing is usable.
The same group is now an icon at the right of the panel; clicking it opens the tabs in a popup with each widget in full.
